notes.content: - Fixed a problem with Electrical Chair

notes.title: Steam Scream Fest 3D - Scholar's Mate is on sale!
notes.content:
[h3]A chilling first-person Escape Room awaits you in Scholar's Mate at the abandoned hospital!
[/h3]

During this new Steam Scream Fest 3D, you can grab Scholar's Mate and save 25% and enjoy a different version with the spooky Eddie! 🎃

Immerse yourself in a terrifying Escape Room where your captor is always lurking in the shadows! 🔪

Can you survive this horrifying night at the abandoned psychiatric hospital? 🏥

[h3]👇Buy Scholar's Mate here 👇
[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2095510?utm_source=jandu&utm_campaign=steamscream2024&utm_medium=steamevent

notes.title: Minor Fix
notes.content:
- fixed a problem with a pumpkin light
- fixed a problem with the corridor door

notes.title: Minor Fix 1.1.21
notes.content:
- Fixed a problem when the YES/NO dialog box appears and the player repeatedly presses the buttons.

-- Now the transition is no longer cut off when leaving a puzzle.

notes.title: Minor Fix 1.1.20
notes.content:
- Fixed a problem when placing books if the action button is pressed continuously.
- Fixed a problem when placing slides if the action button is pressed continuously.

notes.title: Minor Fixes 1.1.19
notes.content:
- Fixed a problem that saved you out of the map in the final cinematic.

- Fixed a visual bug in the final cinematic in certain configurations.

notes.title: Library Fixed Update
notes.content:
Library:
- You no longer lose input when placing a book in the bookcase.

Additional:
- The game no longer crashes or the screen remains black when a save file is lost.

notes.title: Minor fix 1.1.15
notes.content: - Fixed a bug that when the game was reloaded in the bathroom, the water in the bathtub did not keep its current position. That prevented to pick up the Director's key.

notes.title: Minor Update 1.1.14
notes.content:
Minor Update:

- Added checkpoint when enter on Ward º6.
- Added checkpoint when turn on the power of the second floor.
- Added checkpoint when turn on the power of garden.
- Added checkpoint when turn on the water pump.

notes.title: Minor fix - Library
notes.content:
Minor Fix

- fixed a problem with the library, if you opened the inventory when you had to select a book, the control was lost and you need to back to menu.

notes.title: Minor fix
notes.content:
Minor fix

- Default configuration for Game Settings values been fixed.
